title: Audit-only design freeze for genuine non-mutating G01 correlation drill

g01a_provable_target.chain: Meta-shaped admit → Hermes gateway turn → ≥1 Staff /staff/bot/* call with same immutable trace_id
g01a_provable_target.trace_id: UUIDv4 minted once per logical guest turn at Hermes admit
g01a_provable_target.mutation: none — read tools and/or write gates off

g01b_business_join_only.chain: Checkout create Staff request ↔ later Stripe webhook request via payment_id / session_id / metadata.trace_id
g01b_business_join_only.note: Genuine Stripe Checkout Session create always mutates Stripe + typically payments row; webhook is a separate ingress

g01_boundary_redefinition.not_provable_as_single_inbound_als: Meta admit through Stripe webhook without regeneration — physically different HTTP clients

stripe_truth.honest_statement: Genuine Stripe invocation cannot be exercised without mutation. G01 E2E must not claim Stripe as a fourth hop of the inbound ALS; redefine Stripe as G01-B business-ID join after a mutating create.

points.where: Hermes WhatsApp webhook admit (first parse of inbound message / burst first wamid)
points.action: Mint immutable UUIDv4 trace_id once per logical turn; bind to turn context
Bind parent_event_id = Meta messages[].id (wamid); for burst retain source_wamids children
Send X-Request-Id: <trace_id> on every Staff bot POST (and mirror) for the turn
Already accepts strict UUIDv4 — no schema change required if Hermes sends canonical id
Existing request_id field becomes the searchable trace_id in LAW
Copy trace_id + parent_event_id into Stripe metadata + payments metadata for G01-B join only

not_required_for_g01a: Single ALS spanning Meta to Stripe webhook

hard_disabled_dry_run_mode.name: G01_CORRELATION_DRY_RUN
hard_disabled_dry_run_mode.purpose: Exercise real Hermes→Staff internal dispatch while suppressing every WhatsApp send, booking/hold/payment/database write, and Stripe operation

required_all: Explicit operator env G01_CORRELATION_DRY_RUN=1 on Hermes runtime only
Explicit operator env BOT_BOOKING_ENABLED=false and STRIPE_LINKS_ENABLED=false on Staff API (or equivalent fail-closed write gates)
Tenant wolfhouse-somo or sunset only — never production hosts
Confirmation phrase RADAR-16U-CORRELATION-DRY-RUN for any follow-on live apply slice
forbidden: Signed live guest send while dry-run claims active

suppressions: WhatsApp Cloud outbound send (Hermes send path no-op / capture-only)
payment row creates and Stripe checkout.sessions.create
conversation reset / test phone mutation helpers
still_exercised: Hermes Meta-shaped webhook admit + gateway turn
_post_bot to Staff with X-Request-Id once instrumentation lands
Staff ALS + completion log on read routes (availability-check, booking-preview, sunset quote/catalog)
simulate-guest-turn allow_writes=false as offline/staging rehearsal path
not_existing_today: Hard-disabled WhatsApp send suppress switch named G01_CORRELATION_DRY_RUN
stripe_links_dry_run synthetic checkout without Stripe SDK call
fail_closed: If dry-run env unset → normal staging behavior (no silent dry-run)
If any write or Stripe create is attempted while dry-run claimed → refuse and mark drill failed
If trace_id regenerated at Staff (Hermes omitted header) → fail closed for G01-A
If evidence is only independent same-ID probes → reject as non-E2E

tenant_isolation.wolfhouse: LUNA_CLIENT_SLUG=wolfhouse-somo; Staff DEFAULT/client binding wolfhouse-somo; staff-staging host
tenant_isolation.sunset: LUNA_CLIENT_SLUG=sunset; STRIPE_WEBHOOK_CLIENT_SLUG=sunset; sunset-staging host; location via SUNSET_INGRESS_LOCATION_ID

cleanup.policy: Dry-run creates no bookings/holds/payments/guest messages — cleanup is no-op if fail-closed held
cleanup.if_mutation_leaked: Stop drill; mark fail-closed; operator cleanup via existing staging reset tools outside 16U; do not auto-delete in design freeze

evidence_schema_design.pass_rule_g01a: One immutable trace_id minted at Hermes admit equals Staff ALS request_id on ≥1 real /staff/bot/* hop; parent_event_id=wamid; mutation=false; WhatsApp send suppressed; searchable completion in LAW

steps: Hermes mint trace_id + bind wamid; _post_bot send X-Request-Id
Hard-disabled G01_CORRELATION_DRY_RUN send suppress + write gates
Offline + staging read-only drill evidence freeze for G01-A only
Do not claim Stripe Checkout or webhook as inbound ALS
